errors.evidence: The description states that the yellow sector is located in the bottom right part of the chart, but it is actually located on the left and bottom-left side.
The description states that the grey sector is in the upper right part, but it is actually in the middle-to-lower right part. The orange and blue sectors are in the upper right.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори имат етикети с проценти вътре в тях, освен синия и оранжевия, които не са етикетирани с числови стойности.
errors.evidence: The sentence is contradictory. It first claims that all sectors have percentage labels and then immediately states the exceptions. This is confusing and poorly phrased. It should have stated that only the yellow and grey sectors have labels.
